chain.label: Corrosion pits in propeller blade taper bore
chain.trigger: corrosion damage (pitting) in the taper bore

chain.label: Inadequate borescope inspection and improper blend repair masked the crack
chain.trigger: not discovered by Hamilton Standard because of inadequate and ineffective corporate inspection and repair techniques, training, documentation, and communications

caused_by.evidence: a fatigue crack from multiple corrosion pits that were not discovered by Hamilton Standard because of inadequate and ineffective corporate inspection and repair techniques

chain.label: No recurrent ultrasonic inspection required for repaired blades
chain.trigger: failure to require recurrent on-wing ultrasonic inspections for the affected propellers

caused_by.evidence: Hamilton Standard's failure to recommend, and the FAA's failure to require, repetitive ultrasonic inspections...contributed to the accident because the crack in the accident blade would likely have been detected in a recurrent ultrasonic inspection

chain.label: Propeller blade fatigue fracture and in-flight separation
chain.trigger: in-flight fatigue fracture and separation of a propeller blade

caused_by.evidence: The fracture was caused by a fatigue crack from multiple corrosion pits
the crack in the accident blade would likely have been detected in a recurrent ultrasonic inspection

chain.label: Nacelle/gearbox distortion and loss of left engine thrust
chain.trigger: torque on the left engine decreased to zero

caused_by.evidence: several thuds could be heard from the cockpit, and the torque on the left engine decreased to zero

chain.label: Excessive drag and loss of wing lift degraded performance and directional control
chain.trigger: distortion of the left engine nacelle, causing excessive drag, loss of wing lift, and reduced directional control

caused_by.evidence: distortion of the left engine nacelle, causing excessive drag, loss of wing lift, and reduced directional control of the airplane

chain.label: Crew diverted for emergency landing at West Georgia Regional Airport
chain.trigger: unable to maintain altitude and were vectored by air traffic control toward the West Georgia Regional Airport

caused_by.evidence: unable to maintain altitude and were vectored by air traffic control toward the West Georgia Regional Airport (CTJ), Carrollton, Georgia, for an emergency landing

chain.label: Overcast cloud ceiling at accident site
Airplane struck trees and collided with terrain in a left-wing-down attitude
chain.trigger: passed through some trees, and was destroyed by impact forces with the ground

caused_by.evidence: degraded airplane performance, preventing the flightcrew from arresting the airplane's descent or making rapid changes in its direction of flight making a forced landing necessary
The airplane continued its descent, passed through some trees, and was destroyed by impact forces
the cloud ceiling precluded the flightcrew from being able to see the ground and thus to make a more successful forced landing

chain.label: Fatal and serious injuries from impact forces and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: destroyed by ground impact forces and postcrash fire. The captain and four passengers sustained fatal injuries

caused_by.evidence: The airplane...was destroyed by ground impact forces and postcrash fire. The captain and four passengers sustained fatal injuries. Three other passengers died of injuries in the following 30 days.
